cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The treasure map ends at this solid wall. It secretly led us here to wake it. I'm knocking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. And our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then we were sent to hear it in darkness. I'm putting the torch out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's it. The map was testing our breath control. I'm holding mine.

mechanism: A treats successive failures of a treasure expedition as new secret teaching missions, correcting its pupil into immediate participation.
confusable: Not merely calling a failure useful: each failure reveals a different supposed purpose and produces a new action.
comparison: Physical expedition becomes breath lesson versus failed radio contact becomes refusal practice.
seedUse: D161 wall/torch/breath sequence; S05 claiming pupil progress and correcting technique.
